files.description: Water gauge log (120 rows): gauge (gauge name such as "LA-01"), reading (meters, three decimals; about 3% empty), level (alert level, whole number from 3 to 80, no empty cells), site (dam, canal or lake; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Readings at gauges whose alert level is above 60 are unreliable. Compare, per site (lower case, no extra spaces), the mean reading of the raw log with the mean reading after the unreliable readings are blanked out. The log can be large, so keep memory use low. `result` should be a table indexed by site with the columns raw_mean and clean_mean, both rounded to three decimals.
intended_computation: Per site (3 sites): raw_mean = mean of all non-missing readings; clean_mean = mean after readings with level > 60 are set to missing; both rounded to 3 decimals; the raw log itself is not changed.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the no-duplicate conversion shares memory, so blanking the cleaned frame also changes the raw log and both means agree

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
